sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and will be strong favourites against Alsager, who occupy bottom place with just 4 points from 10 matches and arrive in poor form with only one win in their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth in the table, with both teams showing contrasting recent form—Bridgnorth have recovered from two losses with a win, while Eccleshall are on a strong recent run. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community on Saturday, then host Brereton Social in a Wednesday evening fixture. Third-place Bilston Town visit Foley Meir, while mid-table sides including Barnton (home to Shawbury United) and New Mills (away at Market Drayton Town) compete for points. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in what shapes as a basement-battle encounter. Widnes Town, pointless so far, visit Brereton Social on Saturday in another fixture involving struggling sides.
